meta.name: design-system-compliance
meta.description: Check that the UI you actually rendered uses the design system, by reading computed styles in the running app against the project's design tokens. Catches hardcoded hex colors, off-palette backgrounds, invisible or unusable controls, and animations that never ran. Use after building or restyling a component, when a design review is wanted, when a UI looks slightly off but nobody can say why, or when a design system exists and nothing checks whether the code follows it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核对实际渲染的界面有没有用对设计规范,揪出硬编码颜色和没跑起来的动效
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目已有设计规范,却没人核对代码有没有照着做。
copy.tagline_en: Check rendered UI against your design tokens and catch hardcoded colors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has a design system but nothing verifies the code follows it.

howto.what: 它在运行中的页面里读取元素的真实计算样式,对照项目声明的 design token,报出硬编码色值、脱离色板、被遮挡或 0×0 的不可见控件,以及没跑起来的动画,并给出 file:line。
howto.when: 在构建或改完组件样式后、想做设计评审、UI 看着有点不对却说不出原因等情况时接管;有 design system 却没人检查代码是否遵守时也适用。

say.text: 检查这个组件在我运行的应用里有没有用上设计 token
say.note: 会返回 offTheme 报告和 file:line

say.text: 看看这个按钮是不是被遮住了,或者根本点不到
跑一下动画检查,看我加的动效有没有真的执行
say.note: 列出运行中和刚结束的动画及耗时

howto.what_en: It reads computed styles in the running app and compares them against the project's design tokens, flagging hardcoded colors, off-palette backgrounds, occluded or 0×0 controls, and animations that never ran, each with a file:line.
howto.when_en: Use after building or restyling a component, when a design review is wanted, when a UI looks slightly off but nobody can say why, or when a design system exists and nothing checks compliance.

say_en.text: Check whether this component uses the design tokens in my running app
Is this button occluded or too small to click?
Run the animation check to see if my motion actually ran
